sourceCurriculum: Interleaved Cross-Domain Synthesis (OpenStax Prealgebra 2e & Geometry Foundations)

archetypes.name: Spatial Incline & Radical Metric Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Synthesize 3D spatial diagonal and incline distances, simplify to exact radical form, and compute precision decimal bounds.
archetypes.mentalModel: Space diagonal in 3D Euclidean solid coupled with radical extraction and metric rounding.

archetypes.name: Annulus & Inscribed Radical Metric Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Compute concentric circular boundaries with exact radical chords, expressing area and perimeter differences under specified decimal tolerance.
archetypes.mentalModel: Pythagorean chord tangent to inner boundary generating exact radical radius difference.

archetypes.name: Conical Frustum Slant & Radical Flow Metric
archetypes.coreConcept: Determine the slant height of a truncated conical reservoir using Pythagorean difference of radii, reduce exact radical, and estimate metric volume rate.
archetypes.mentalModel: Right trapezoid axial cross-section yielding hypotenuse slant height with radical and decimal scaling.
